items.title: Are You Overpaying For Pfizer Stock Versus Its Rivals?
items.summary: Pfizer's shares cost more than Johnson & Johnson's for each dollar of reported profit, even after factoring in a loss quarter over the past year. Investors usually pay more for growth, yet Pfizer (PFE) had the weakest sales growth of the six companies in its peer group. Are you overpaying for Pfizer stock versus its rivals.

items.title: Moderna vs. BioNTech: Which mRNA Stock Is the Better Buy Now?

items.title: What Is Merck Stock's Biggest Opportunity?
items.summary: Merck (MRK) stock returned 96% in the past twelve months, against 16.8% for the S&P 500. With the shares 4.0% below their 52-week high, you need a reason Merck can keep growing. In its fiscal Q2 2026 call, management looked past its best-selling drug to newer ones. So what is Merck stock's biggest opportunity from here.

items.title: After Moderna's Dizzying Rally, It's Time To Sell, Says Analyst
items.summary: After nearly quadrupling over the past month, it's time to get out of Moderna stock, a Citi analyst said Wednesday as he downgraded shares.

items.title: Moderna Stock Has Run Too Far, Too Fast. Why Citi Just Downgraded It to Sell.
items.summary: Citi downgrades Moderna to Sell from Hold, saying the data around its cancer vaccine, instimeran autogene, isn’t enough to justify the valuation.

items.title: Moderna Sinks 6% on Citi Downgrade; Merck and Pfizer Stay Flat
items.summary: Citigroup just slapped a Sell rating on one of 2026's most explosive biotech stocks, warning that soaring investor hopes around a cancer vaccine partnership with Merck have carried the valuation into dangerous territory.
